home.title: Your workspace
home.description: Manage your own endpoints, models and platform access from one place.
home.signedOutBody: Sign in with Discord to see resources owned by your account. The service, not this page, decides access and ownership.

endpoints.title: Endpoint management
endpoints.description: Keep endpoint metadata here; upstream secrets are never returned after submission.
endpoints.baseUrlHint: Use an HTTPS or HTTP URL. The server applies its canonical form.
endpoints.deleteBody: Deleting an endpoint also invalidates its keys, fetched models and bindings. This cannot be undone.
endpoints.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL without user information, query parameters or a fragment.
endpoints.noEndpointsBody: Add an endpoint to begin fetching the models available to your keys.
endpoints.secretHint: The key is encrypted by the server and is not shown or copied after this form is submitted.
endpoints.keyHidden: Secret hidden; only metadata is available
endpoints.noKeysBody: Add a key to fetch the upstream model list.
endpoints.modelsEmpty: No models returned for this key
endpoints.modelsEmptyBody: The server returned an empty list. No local placeholder models are shown.
endpoints.similarUrlHint: The server may keep path and slash differences separate; review the canonical URL before saving.
endpoints.keySaved: Key metadata saved. The secret is no longer available in this page.
endpoints.refreshAccepted: Refresh accepted; the server will update the model cache.
endpoints.deleteKeyBody: Deleting this key immediately removes its fetched models and bindings from routing. This cannot be undone.
endpoints.endpointLimit: If the endpoint limit is reached, the server will reject new endpoints without changing existing ones.

models.title: Models and bindings
models.description: Define platform model names and connect them to server-fetched upstream models.
models.noModelsBody: Create a model name before adding bindings.
models.noBindingsBody: This model is a draft until at least one upstream binding is added.
models.deleteBindingBody: The platform model will remain, but this upstream route will no longer be used.
models.invalidOrder: Order must be a non-negative whole number.
models.noEndpointsForBinding: Create and enable an endpoint before adding a binding.
models.deleteModelBody: Deleting a model also deletes its bindings. This cannot be undone.
models.invalidParts: Provider and model are required, must be at most 64 characters, and cannot contain control characters or surrounding whitespace.
models.noEndpointKeys: No enabled endpoint keys are available for binding.
models.noFetchedModels: No fetched models are available for this key.

keys.title: Platform caller key
keys.description: Use this one-time-visible key with the OpenAI-compatible platform exit.
keys.noKeyBody: Generate a caller key only when you are ready to store it in your own password manager or client configuration.
keys.regenerateBody: The current key stops working immediately. The new plaintext is shown once and is cleared when this notice is closed.
keys.oneTimeBody: This is the only time the full caller key is available. It is held in memory only; close this notice after saving it.
keys.copyDone: Copied; close this notice when finished
keys.copyWarning: Clipboard access is an explicit action and is not saved by this page.

issues.title: Issue center
issues.description: Review server-recorded fetch and routing issues without exposing upstream credentials.
issues.emptyBody: The service has not returned any issue records for this account.

account.title: Account and data
account.description: Review account metadata, usage and the two-step data controls.
account.elevateBody: Export and deletion require a fresh Discord re-authorization. Start the server flow before attempting either action.
account.elevationStarted: The server authorization flow has started. Return here after completing it.
account.elevationUnavailable: The authorization flow could not be started safely. Try again later.
account.elevationRequired: Complete a fresh authorization before using this action.
account.elevatedToken: Elevated token (memory only, if provided by the service)
account.elevatedTokenHint: This value is never placed in a URL, browser storage or query cache.
account.exportBody: The server export contains metadata and usage summaries, never plaintext upstream secrets. The downloaded file is created locally and is not retained by this page.
account.deleteBody: This permanently removes linked endpoints, keys, models, bindings, logs and caller-key metadata after server-side elevation. Type DELETE to continue.
account.deleteWordError: Type DELETE exactly to confirm account deletion.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains the data needed to operate NonbiriAPI in alpha.1.
privacy.identityBody: The user station uses Discord OAuth for registration and sign-in. The service keeps the account and session metadata needed to authenticate you. Session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite according to the deployment configuration.
privacy.credentialsBody: Endpoint metadata is associated with your account. Upstream credentials are encrypted at rest and are never returned in lists, logs, alerts or exports. This browser receives key metadata only; it does not persist upstream secrets.
privacy.trafficBody: Forwarded requests are recorded as bounded metadata such as timestamps, status and usage. Request and response content is not stored. Bounded diagnostics may contain sanitized upstream context for troubleshooting.
privacy.retentionBody: Request logs are retained for up to 30 days before cleanup. You can request an account export and account deletion through the elevated self-service flow. An export excludes plaintext upstream secrets.
privacy.securityBody: The service applies ownership checks, outbound request protections and no-store responses to sensitive API operations. Do not place secrets in notes, URLs or support messages.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By using NonbiriAPI, you agree to use the service lawfully and protect your own credentials.
terms.useBody: Use only endpoints and models you are authorized to access. Do not use the platform to bypass provider controls, send unlawful content, attack systems or interfere with other users.
terms.credentialsBody: Keep upstream credentials and your caller key confidential. Regenerate a caller key immediately if it may have been exposed. Notes and model names are not a secure place for secrets.
terms.availabilityBody: Requests may be limited, rejected or unavailable because of configured quotas, upstream failures, maintenance or authorization. A successful HTTP response is not a promise that an upstream operation completed unless the protocol response is complete.
terms.dataBody: The privacy policy describes metadata retention and account controls. Account deletion is destructive and removes linked data after the required elevated confirmation.
terms.changesBody: The operator may update these terms for a new release. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised text.
